title: Keeping fit in different ways
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a testmozgásról, a fitneszkultúráról és az egészséges öregedésről.

scenes.description: In a modern city gym full of mirrors and machines, a young man is lifting weights while his friend films him on a phone for social media. Behind them, rows of people are running on treadmills, each wearing earphones and looking at a screen. A poster on the wall shows a muscular model and the slogan 'No pain, no gain'. The atmosphere is competitive and a little impersonal.

Early on a misty morning, a group of retired people are doing gentle exercises together in a park by a river. A woman in her seventies is leading the group, and everyone is following her slow movements and smiling. A middle-aged man is jogging past with his dog, and some ducks are swimming on the water. It looks peaceful and sociable.

prompts: Compare the two approaches to exercise and what motivates the people.
How does social media influence the way young people think about their bodies and fitness?
What is the key to staying healthy throughout your life?
followUpQuestions: Why do some people give up exercising after a few weeks?
Do you think going to the gym has become a fashion rather than a healthy habit?
How can older people stay active and healthy?
Should PE lessons at school be different? How?
